gen-luckiest-guy-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Loud, cheerful and poured-looking, Luckiest Guy hangs its mean line up high. Atkinson Hyperlegible, a sans-serif with wide-set terminals on its s, follows quietly, and a heading around twice the body size would keep that gap obvious.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its clipped capitals and ascenders out like stretched stencil bridges, leaving each letter room to breathe. Luckiest Guy earns its keep big and short.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads contemporary and friendly, its lowercase eyes big as washers and its rounds left unlatched. Luckiest Guy brings the shout, one uniform ink line that never swells or thins, and that single-minded loudness is what you remember.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-biryani: Biryani keeps its lowercase clear and unclogged, with no thick-and-thin modulation anywhere in its strokes. But Luckiest Guy is the one to enlarge, so a heading well above the body size lets its loud, poured ink dominate.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-blinker: Cheerful shouting, poured thick. Luckiest Guy sets a mean high line over Blinker, a sans whose lowercase fills most of the height and whose open apertures let text move along smoothly, line after line.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-carrois-gothic: Luckiest Guy has a flat, stencil-cut look from its single-weight strokes, loud and cheerful. Carrois Gothic, a sans-serif with a high x-height and generous opening in c, sits below it, so a much larger heading keeps the two clearly apart.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Single-weight ink, shouting with good cheer. Luckiest Guy sits over Carrois Gothic SC, a sans-serif whose capitals and lowercase are nearly the same height, so the heading does all the loud talking while the text underneath stays level.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-chivo: Neon-tube letters, loud and glowing. Luckiest Guy holds one steady line thickness, but if it shrinks too small, Chivo, a plain sans with lowercase packed up toward the caps, would pull the attention away.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-chocolate-classical-: Luckiest Guy lays down a thread of ink with no swelling or tapering, cheerful and loud. Yet its best trick is the foil of Chocolate Classical Sans, a plain sans whose broad-nibbed pen stroke never curls shut.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-fresca: Fresca drops the calligraphic thinning entirely, keeping its counters linked to the outside space beneath short ascenders and big bowls. Luckiest Guy brings the cheer, a loud poured line that Fresca's sans text never tries to match.
